notes.title: Intergalactic Bubbles Launches onto iOS!
notes.content:
[img]https://hellscapegames.files.wordpress.com/2015/10/igbbanner_800x200.png[/img]
[h1][b]Intergalactic Bubbles is on the App Store![/b][/h1]
At long last, mobile Apple gamers can enjoy the same stellar action that Android and PC gamers have been raving about. Intergalactic Bubbles is now LIVE on the iTunes Store. With this launch, you can now blast bubbles through space on iPhone or iPad.

[h1][b]Download Intergalactic Bubbles for iOS right now from the [url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/intergalactic-bubbles/id990012864]Apple App Store[/url].[/b][/h1]

[url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/intergalactic-bubbles/id990012864][img]https://hellscapegames.files.wordpress.com/2013/09/download_on_the_app_store_badge_us-uk_135x401.png[/img][/url]

Already enjoy Intergalactic Bubbles? Remember to add a review to the new app page so more players can share the fun.

Android users, you can download Intergalactic Bubbles from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HellscapeGames.IntergalacticBubbles]Google Play[/url].
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HellscapeGames.IntergalacticBubbles][img]https://hellscapegames.files.wordpress.com/2013/12/googleplay.png[/img][/url]

Thanks for playing,
[url=http://hellscapegames.com/]Hellscape Games[/url]

notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
[b]Due to community demand,[/b]
[h1][i]Achievements have been added to Intergalactic Bubbles![/i][/h1]

This first set of basic achievements will let you show off your progress and have a permanent record of your bubble blasting prowess for all to admire. See the full list on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/351490/achievements]achievements page[/url].

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/351490/achievements][img]https://gallery.mailchimp.com/50f079bdb39d4a7425282b658/images/fffe3f28-4d5a-4c47-b63b-023dc1608a81.png[/img][/url]

If you have been playing Intergalactic Bubbles for a while already, there is no need to replay levels, just relaunch the game and you will be awarded all of the achievements you have earned so far.

If you want to chat about achievements or have ideas on new ones you want to see added, head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/351490/discussions/0/594820473980423140/]community hub achievements thread[/url]. I'll be there to share the news, get feedback, and answer any questions.

[h1]Review Challenge[/h1]
Do you enjoy Intergalactic Bubbles and think more people should play it? Encourage other gamers by adding a review on the Steam [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/351490]store page[/url]. At the end of August, I will make sure there are as many achievements as reviews on Steam. 

Thanks for playing!
